name: Spontaneous Chill
body:
Instead of casting a cure spell, you can instead cast a spell with the [cold descriptor].

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, ability to spontaneously cast cure or inflict spells, Arctic domain or Ice subdomain.

Benefit(s): You can “lose” a prepared spell to cast a spell with the cold descriptor at least one level lower, instead of casting a cure spell or an inflict spell as you normally would. The spontaneously cast spell must appear on your class’s spell list.
